title: LauncherStatus
description: What the host launcher knows: whether the game runs, the last launch and what happened to the wheel bindings (GET /status and POST /launch on paddock-launcher).

at.description: When Content Manager was asked to start the game.

state.description: watching: the game was launched and has not exited yet. unchanged: after the game, the controllers and every JOY binding were as backed up. restored: they differed, and the backup was written back. restore_failed: they differed and the backup could not be written back (the backup file is kept).

backup_sha256.description: SHA-256 of controls.ini as backed up before the launch.

detail.description: What differed, or why the restore failed.
